newsitem.title: INDIA: India SAIL produces 9.8 mln steel in 1996.
newsitem.headline: India SAIL produces 9.8 mln steel in 1996.

text.p: India's state-run Steel Authority of India Ltd (SAIL) produced a record 9.8 million tonnes of steel in calendar 1996, up four percent compared to 1995, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said on Wednesday.
The agency said SAIL produced more than 11 million tonnes of hot metal and crude steel in 1996.
The record output was achieved through cost reductions, improved operations and upgraded technology, PTI quoted a company statement as saying.
